purpose: Define the candidate role, risk, and resolver vocabulary allowed in app/local first mission candidate pools.

mission_candidate_roles.definition: A safe route start or comparison point supported by strong survey evidence or page1_core recognition.
mission_candidate_roles.openai_instruction: Use as a known or likely-known reference point, not as a promoted Atlas Landmark.

mission_candidate_roles.definition: A connective candidate that tests adjacency from an anchor into a nearby lane.
mission_candidate_roles.openai_instruction: Explain what relationship is being tested and keep the inference scoped.

mission_candidate_roles.definition: A candidate that tests promising but uncertain taste territory.
mission_candidate_roles.openai_instruction: Frame as an experiment, not a recommendation certainty.

mission_candidate_roles.definition: A candidate that tests a taste boundary or false-nearby edge.
mission_candidate_roles.openai_instruction: Use sparingly. Say what boundary it tests. Do not treat a negative response as final Dead End proof.

mission_candidate_roles.definition: A cautious candidate that may look nearby but often fails for a known reason.
mission_candidate_roles.openai_instruction: Use only when the mission design needs a controlled trap/boundary item. Never frame as a standard recommendation.

mission_candidate_roles.definition: A useful but not-yet-promotable candidate for comfort, context, bridging, or weak positive evidence.
mission_candidate_roles.openai_instruction: Use as support or connective tissue. Do not promote to Atlas Waypoint without Atlas logic.

mission_candidate_roles.definition: A low-risk spacing item used to keep a mission listenable between harder probes.
mission_candidate_roles.openai_instruction: Use only if it still teaches something. Avoid filler with no signal value.

mission_candidate_roles.definition: A candidate that may be useful but is blocked from automatic OpenAI mission generation until human review resolves risk.
mission_candidate_roles.openai_instruction: Do not send to OpenAI automatic mission generation.

risk_classes.definition: Approved, survey-safe, unquarantined, clear object identity, low version ambiguity.
Approved and survey-safe but requires careful inference, scoped use, or known genre/context caution.
Approved but likely to overfit, irritate, confuse, or test a sharp boundary if used casually.
Potentially useful but blocked from automatic first mission generation until resolver/version/special-entity review completes.
Suppressed, quarantined, context-only, unresolved, unsafe, or raw-graph-only candidate.

candidate_pool_behavior_alignment.meaning: Route start or comparison anchor. Operational only; does not create an Atlas Landmark.
Connective test between known evidence and nearby territory.
Uncertain candidate that tests promising territory.
False-nearby or boundary test. Use sparingly and never as a conclusion.
Useful support/context candidate. Does not create an Atlas Waypoint.
Dead-end check or negative-control probe. Does not create an Atlas Dead End.
Keep out of automatic Survey, Mission Generation, Supabase active rows, and OpenAI prompts.
Allowed only as an upstream unresolved state; local Alpha candidate pools must map to a concrete role before OpenAI.
